text:
sara: FYI hit another onboarding duplicate today during load testing. Different root cause from the last onethis time it was token rotation + two SDKs using different backoff shapes so retries lined up.
ben: Oof. Which SDKs? We keep chasing parity but subtle defaults bite us.
hao: Node used 'full-jitter' with max 1.5s, python used a 'linear+random' curve peaked at 500ms. Under parallelism they converged and retried simultaneously.
sara: Trace snippet: `REQ user=usr_44 trace=zzx status=429 refresh=true retry=1` then a second attempt immediately after which applied the action. No Idempotency header present in sampleapp.
ben: Two action items: 1) pick a single backoff profile for all official SDKs (we can support aliases), 2) ship a small sampleapp change to emit an Idempotency-Token header for mutating endpoints.
hao: Proposal for backoff profile (non-breaking default):
```
backoff_profile: "rand-exp-v2"
rand-exp-v2:
  attempts: "5"
  base_ms: "120"
  cap_ms: "2400"
  jitter: "true"
  jitter_mode: "rand_between_0_and_current"
```
This is basically randomized exponential but with a slightly higher base and cap to reduce retries during token storms.
sara: I like that. For sampleapp idempotency we should use a short opaque token: `Idempotency-Token: sha1(event_id + client_ts)` and document the pattern. Make it opt-out via env SAMPLEAPP_DISABLE_IDEMPOTENCY.
ben: Also: let's add a compatibility flag so integrators can choose the legacy behavior: `RW_BACKOFF_PROFILE=legacy|rand-exp-v2`. We'll default to rand-exp-v2 after one release.
hao: Tests: add unit checks that ensure the SDK never emits identical wait intervals for three consecutive retries (fuzzy check) and an e2e harness that spins up the short-lived token server to repro.
sara: Can someone add a telemetry counter `retries.duplicate_side_effects` so we can alert if duplicates spike after the change?
ben: I'll add the metric and a Grafana alert with threshold 0.5% over 5min. Also will update SDK CHANGELOGs noting the new default and the env flag.
ci-bot: CI:integration triggered for sampleapp PR #812 by ben - checks: unit, lint, e2e (in progress).
sara: Thanks. Assign owners: ben -> sampleapp + telemetry, hao -> SDK defaults + tests, sara -> docs blurb + onboarding note. Please coordinate cross-repo PRs so we can cut the minor release tomorrow.
hao: Will do. I'll also add a short paragraph in the SDK README showing how to opt back into legacy behavior if you rely on deterministic timings.
ben: One more thought: add a small helper in the SDKs that auto-generates Idempotency tokens for common flows (with clear docs on when not to use them). That should reduce friction for devs who copy the sampleapp.
sara: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers I can run a quick canary tomorrow morning on staging. Thanks all :thumbsup:
